declare

begin

IF :STAFF_DETAILS.STAFF_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
BEGIN

BEGIN
SELECT d_area_code||'-'||substr(d_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(d_phone_no,4),
 h_area_code||'-'||substr(h_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(h_phone_no,4),
 m_area_code||'-'||substr(m_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(m_phone_no,4),
 substr(pager,1,3)||'-'||substr(pager,4,3)||'-'||substr(pager,7)
INTO :CONTROL_BLK.WORK_PHONE,
 :CONTROL_BLK.HOME_PHONE,
 :CONTROL_BLK.MOBILE,
 :CONTROL_BLK.PAGER
FROM ADDRESSES
WHERE ADDRESS_ID = :STAFF_DETAILS.ADDRESS_ID;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
:CONTROL_BLK.WORK_PHONE := NULL;
:CONTROL_BLK.HOME_PHONE := NULL;
:CONTROL_BLK.MOBILE := NULL;
:CONTROL_BLK.PAGER := NULL;
END;
:CONTROL_BLK.STAFF_NAME := :STAFF_DETAILS.LAST_NAME_INIT ||', '||:STAFF_DETAILS.FIRST_NAME_INIT;

:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 5;
:CONTROL_BLK.MONTH_NAME := NULL;
set_block_property('STAFF_OFF_DAY',default_where,'staff_no = ' ||''''||:staff_details.staff_no||'''') ;
go_block('Staff_OFF_DAY');
clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
EXECUTE_QUERY;
:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 0;


BEGIN
 SELECT distinct ssh.schedule_id, ssh.start_date, substr(ssh.status,1,1)
 INTO :control_blk.SCHEDULE_ID, :control_blk.start_date, 
 :control_blk.sch_status
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_HDR ssh,
 STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS ssd
 WHERE trunc(v_date+7) between trunc(ssh.start_date) and trunc(ssh.end_date)
 AND ssd.STAFF_NO = :STAFF_DETAILS.STAFF_NO
 AND ssd.schedule_id = ssh.schedule_id
 AND ssh.status != 'CANCL'
 AND rownum < 2 ;

 GO_BLOCK('DRIVES');CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 GO_BLOCK('STAFF_DETAILS');

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 

 begin
 SELECT distinct ssh.schedule_id, ssh.start_date, substr(ssh.status,1,1)
 INTO :control_blk.SCHEDULE_ID, :control_blk.start_date, 
 :control_blk.sch_status
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_HDR ssh,
 STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS ssd
 WHERE trunc(v_date) between trunc(ssh.start_date) and trunc(ssh.end_date)
 AND ssd.STAFF_NO = :STAFF_DETAILS.STAFF_NO
 AND ssd.schedule_id = ssh.schedule_id
 AND ssh.status != 'CANCL';
 
 GO_BLOCK('DRIVES');CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 GO_BLOCK('STAFF_DETAILS');

 exception WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN 
 :control_blk.SCHEDULE_ID := NULL;
 :control_blk.start_date := NULL;
 :control_blk.sch_status := NULL;

 GO_BLOCK('DRIVES');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 GO_BLOCK('STAFF_DETAILS');
 end;
WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 handle_error;
END;
 
don_mcal_common.staff_weekly_hours(:control_blk.SCHEDULE_ID,:STAFF_DETAILS.STAFF_NO,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :drives.display_tot_time );

END;
END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
sub_time number;
add_time number ;
travel_time number ;
BEGIN
BEGIN
 SELECT sp.name, sp.sponsor_id
 INTO :drives.sponsor, :drives.sponsor_id
 FROM sponsors sp, drive_sponsors dsp
 WHERE dsp.drive_id = :drives.drive_id 
 AND sp.sponsor_id = dsp.sponsor_id
 AND rownum = 1;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 handle_error;
END;

:drives.day := to_char(:drives.drive_date,'Dy');
:drives.schedule_id := :control_blk.schedule_id;
:drives.staff_no := :staff_details.staff_no;

/***
BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = :DRIVES.SCHEDULE_ID 
 AND DRIVE_ID = :DRIVES.DRIVE_ID 
 AND STAFF_NO = :DRIVES.STAFF_NO) ;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(travel_time, 0 ) 
 INTO travel_time
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = :drives.location_id ;
 travel_time := travel_time / (24*60) ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 travel_time := 0 ;
 END;
 :drives.schedule_start := :drives.schedule_start_time - (:drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time/(2*24*60)) - sub_time - travel_time;
 :drives.schedule_end := :drives.schedule_end_time + (:drives.schedule_stup_bkdown_time/(2*24*60)) + add_time + travel_time;

****/
 Declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 BEGIN
 SELECT actual_bod, actual_eod 
 INTO :drives.schedule_start, :drives.schedule_end
 FROM staff_schedule_details
 WHERE schedule_id = :control_blk.schedule_id 
 AND staff_no = :staff_details.staff_no
 AND drive_id = :drives.drive_id;

 -- time zone change --02/16/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:drives.schedule_start_time,v_local_time);
 :drives.schedule_start := v_local_time;
 :drives.s_drive_date := to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR');
 else
 :drives.schedule_start := sysdate;
 :drives.s_drive_date := to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-RR'); 
 end if; 

 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:drives.schedule_end_time,v_local_time);
 :drives.schedule_end := v_local_time;
 else
 :drives.schedule_end := sysdate;
 end if; 
 

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :drives.schedule_start := '';
 :drives.schedule_end := '';
 END;


END;

 --:global.program_version := '1.01.05';

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PIGGY_DRIVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_piggy_drive (x_drive_id varchar , x_piggy_flg out VARCHAR2,h_piggy_start_time out date,h_piggy_end_time out date)IS
begin
declare
piggy_drive_id drive_groups.drive_id%type;
x_piggy_start_time drives.drive_date%type;
x_piggy_end_time drives.drive_date%type;
BEGIN
 x_piggy_flg := 'Y';
 begin
 select a.drive_id
 into piggy_drive_id 
 from drive_groups a,drives b
 where drive_group_type='PIGGY' and
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = x_drive_id)
 and a.drive_id != x_drive_id and
 a.drive_id = b.drive_id and
 b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 rownum=1;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 x_piggy_flg := 'N';
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 if(x_piggy_flg = 'Y') then
 calc_drive_sch_times(piggy_drive_id,x_piggy_start_time,x_piggy_end_time,:global.chapter_id);
 
 h_piggy_start_time := x_piggy_start_time;
 
 h_piggy_end_time := x_piggy_end_time; 
 end if;
END;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

RecordGroup.Name: LAST_SCHEDULE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT SSH.SCHEDULE_ID, 
to_char(SSH.START_DATE,'MM-DD-YY') START_DATE,
 to_char(SSH.END_DATE,'MM-DD-YY') END_DATE,
substr(SSH.STATUS ,1,1) status
FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_HDR SSH, STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS SSD
WHERE SSH.STATUS != 'CANCL'
AND SSD.STAFF_NO = :STAFF_DETAILS.STAFF_NO
AND SSH.SCHEDULE_ID = SSD.SCHEDULE_ID
AND trunc(SSH.START_DATE) BETWEEN trunc(SYSDATE-365) AND trunc(SYSDATE)
ORDER BY to_date(to_char(SSH.START_DATE,'MM-DD-YY'),'MM-DD-YY') desc
